# Creativo@Work

> A New York web and platform development studio. We build custom web applications, headless commerce, and learning platforms for small to mid-sized companies — and modernize legacy systems that outgrew their stack.

Creativo@Work LLC is a small studio based at 195 Plymouth Street, Suite 5/5, Brooklyn, NY 11201, founded in 2020. We deliberately stay small: the people who scope a project are the people who build it, with no account-manager layer between the brief and the code. Most engagements start with something that already exists — a platform that outgrew its stack, a site nobody can edit without a developer, an internal tool held together by spreadsheets.

## Services

- **Custom application engineering** — auth, dashboards, APIs, and data models. Software with a real architecture, not a CMS bent into the shape of one.
- **Legacy platform modernization** — aging codebases moved onto current stacks incrementally, in production, without a year-long rewrite.
- **Headless and composable front-ends** — React and TypeScript against a decoupled CMS, so the editing experience and the front end stop constraining each other.
- **eCommerce engineering** — storefronts that load fast, convert well, and scale with the catalog.
- **Learning platforms** — LMS builds with cohort, certification, and reporting features.
- **AI feature integration** — retrieval over your own content, assisted workflows, and the evaluation work to know whether it helps.
- **Cloud infrastructure and delivery** — pipelines, environments, monitoring.
- **Product and interface design** — interface design grounded in your audience and goals.
- **Performance, SEO and analytics** — Core Web Vitals, technical SEO, and instrumentation.

## Technology

TypeScript, React, headless and composable architecture, eCommerce platforms, cloud infrastructure and CI/CD, AI and LLM feature integration.

## Who we work with

Founders, marketing leads, and creative directors at small-to-midsize companies who need a partner across strategy, design, build, and the long tail of optimization after launch.

## Frequently asked questions

Full answers: https://creativoatwork.com/faq

- **What does Creativo@Work do?** A New York web and platform development studio building custom web applications, headless and composable front-ends, commerce platforms, and learning systems — and modernizing platforms that outgrew their stack.
- **Do you work with clients outside New York?** Yes. We are a New York studio and work with clients anywhere in the world — engagements have spanned North America, Europe, and Latin America. Remote is the default we build around: written updates, recorded walkthroughs, and shared staging environments you can open at any hour.
- **What does a project cost?** Quoted as a fixed price per project after a scoping conversation. Complexity drives the number — user roles, payments, data migration, integrations, and whether a live platform must keep running during modernization.
- **How long does a project take?** Set during scoping and planned in increments that ship, so working software appears early rather than in a single reveal at the end.
- **Can you modernize a legacy platform without a full rewrite?** Yes — incremental modernization is our core specialty and, for most businesses, the smartest strategy. We modernize step-by-step in production without disrupting live operations: core features are isolated, moved onto modern architecture, and run alongside the old system until proven. Immediate value at every phase, zero downtime, total risk control.
- **What is a headless or composable front end?** The system your team writes content in is separated from the system visitors see. The front end is a real application — React and TypeScript — pulling content over an API. Right when the editorial and front-end experiences constrain each other; wrong when a single conventional site would do the job.
- **Can an online store handle a large catalog?** Yes — it is an engineering question, not a limit. Stores slow down from unaudited extensions, unindexed queries, uncached product pages, and oversized images. Every one of those has a fix.
- **Custom LMS or off-the-shelf?** Off-the-shelf wins for self-paced courses sold to individuals. Custom wins for cohort programs, accreditation audit trails, B2B seat licensing, specific reporting shapes, or CRM and student-records integration.
- **What does AI feature integration mean?** Retrieval grounded in your own content, assisted workflows with a human reviewing, and the evaluation work that proves whether either actually helps.
- **Do you support what you build after launch?** Yes — updates, monitoring, Core Web Vitals, analytics, and ongoing improvement. Clients own their code and infrastructure, and the work is documented for handover.
